# Training loop for the simpler linear model
epochs = 2000
for epoch in range(epochs):
    # Forward pass
    outputs = model(X)
    loss = criterion(outputs, y)

    # Backward pass and optimization
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()

    # Print loss occasionally
    if (epoch + 1) % 200 == 0:
        print(f'Epoch [{epoch+1}/{epochs}], Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')
